stories.title: Anthropic joins AI’s natural gas frenzy, buys $3.4B worth of turbines
stories.take: Anthropic bought $3.4B in natural gas turbines to power its AI buildout — the latest sign the race is now about securing electricity, with buyer's-remorse risk if demand shifts.

stories.title: Nvidia CEO's affair becomes a national security problem
stories.take: Nvidia is probing whether Chinese intelligence targeted CEO Jensen Huang through an affair — a personal scandal that has become a national-security and succession problem for the world's most valuable chipmaker.

stories.title: Waymo robotaxis kept illegally passing school buses after software fix, feds say
stories.take: Federal regulators say Waymo robotaxis kept illegally passing school buses even after a software fix rolled out nearly a year ago — a safety failure that undercuts the self-driving pitch.

stories.title: Meta expands Instagram’s AI age-guessing tech globally
stories.take: Meta is expanding Instagram's AI age-guessing worldwide, scanning for clues that users are teens even when they list an adult birthday.

stories.title: Musk says Tesla will refund some Cybertruck deposits, defends decision to end production
stories.take: Tesla will refund some Cybertruck deposits and end production in about eight months — Musk defended the call, closing the book on the truck experiment.

stories.title: The climate case for AI has not been made
stories.take: MIT Tech Review argues the climate case for AI has not been made — as COP talks meet in Turkey, claims that AI will cut emissions remain unproven against its surging energy use.

stories.title: Ogilvy and CAA launch partnership to clone celebrity talent for AI ads
stories.take: Ogilvy and CAA launched Echo to clone celebrity talent for AI ads — Terry Crews and athletes could appear in generated ads, labeled as such, with rights and trust built into the pitch.

stories.title: ChatGPT is about to show brands their mention count
stories.take: ChatGPT is testing an analytics dashboard that shows brands how often they show up in its answers — mention count is becoming a marketing metric.

stories.title: How performance metrics are rewriting creator rate cards
stories.take: Creator rate cards are being rewritten by performance: advertisers now demand cost per lead and conversions, not follower counts.

stories.title: Disney Hitches Its Holiday Campaign to an Invisible Horse
stories.take: Disney's holiday campaign centers on an invisible horse and a boy named Jack rediscovering the season — a three-minute, imagination-first spot.

stories.title: Pepsi’s holiday push includes bigger retail presence, soda for Santa
stories.take: Pepsi's holiday push pairs a bigger retail presence and 'soda for Santa' with more football-season weight behind 'Food Deserves Pepsi.'

stories.title: Reaves steps into Luka's shoes, drops 43 in win vs. Pistons
stories.take: With Luka Doncic resting, Austin Reaves dropped 43 to lead the Lakers past the Pistons 121-116 — a star turn in the MVP candidate's shoes.

stories.title: Giannis on Doc criticism: I won't be thwarted by 'bitterness or pettiness'
stories.take: Giannis said he was 'speechless' at Doc Rivers' criticism of his game, refusing to be thwarted by 'bitterness or pettiness' from his former coach.

stories.title: 'Right now, we don't trust one another': What's fueling the rocky start for Giannis and the Heat
stories.take: At 4-6, Giannis and the Heat admit 'right now, we don't trust one another' — and every loss raises pressure with his free agency looming.

stories.title: Brown says 'nothing to talk about' with Tatum ahead of Celtics-76ers
stories.take: Jaylen Brown says there's 'nothing to talk about' with Jayson Tatum ahead of Sixers-Celtics — nine seasons together in Boston, now a reunion with an edge.

stories.title: Thunder trade grades: OKC swipes promising young wing Nique Clifford from the rebuilding Kings
stories.take: Oklahoma City swiped young wing Nique Clifford from the rebuilding Kings for two second-round picks — another low-cost upside move by the Thunder.

stories.title: MLB rumors: GM meetings could ramp up hot stove activity, plus why the Cubs may already be out on Tarik Skubal
stories.take: GM meetings could ignite the hot stove this week — and the Cubs may already be out on Tarik Skubal, narrowing the ace's market early.

stories.title: Your guide to MLB free agency: Rankings and contract projections for the top 50 free agents
stories.take: ESPN ranks the top 50 free agents with contract projections — the guide to how much this winter's biggest stars are likely to get paid.

stories.title: Pedro Martinez appeals to MLB, players: 'Get something done' to avoid lockout
stories.take: Pedro Martinez appealed to owners and players alike: 'Get something done' — don't lock out baseball for the fans as the Dec. 1 CBA deadline nears.

stories.title: MLB Awards Week: Predictions and everything you need to know about MVP, Cy Young and more
stories.take: Awards Week starts tonight with the rookies — predictions and the full case for MVP, Cy Young and the rest of 2026's hardware.

stories.title: Trump attempts to cast doubt on Democrats’ midterm election victory, questioning early vote numbers and ballot machines – live
stories.take: Trump is casting doubt on the Democrats' midterm win, questioning early votes and ballot machines after first suggesting he would accept the landslide — live updates.

stories.title: Congress is back after GOP's midterm defeat. And, Trump appoints new chief of staff
stories.take: Congress returns after the GOP's midterm defeat and Trump has named Stephen Miller chief of staff — a hardline pick that signals confrontation, not compromise.

stories.title: Trump says his deportation policy 'might have been too tough' for midterm voters
stories.take: Trump conceded his deportation policy 'might have been too tough' for midterm voters and said he may work with Democrats on an immigration deal.

stories.title: Economic relief is on the way, Democrats say. But what, how and when?
stories.take: Democrats promise 'relief is on the way' on costs, corporations and billionaire power — but what, how and when is still undefined.

stories.title: WATCH LIVE: Hegseth speaks at the Naval War College as possible impeachment vote looms
stories.take: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth speaks at the Naval War College as a possible impeachment vote tops the lame-duck Congress agenda.

stories.title: Russell Brand is sentenced to more than 10 years in prison for rape and sexual assault
stories.take: Russell Brand was sentenced to more than 10 years in prison for rape and sexual assault — a jury convicted him on attacks dating back to 2004.

stories.title: After Silicon Valley spending spree, more moderate Democrats are heading to the Capitol
stories.take: After a Silicon Valley spending spree by tech-backed super PACs, more moderate Democrats are heading to the Capitol — nearly all their favored candidates won despite broad distrust of AI and billionaires.

stories.title: Backlash against Trump, ICE raids, gas prices fuels changing political tide in California heartland
stories.take: Backlash to Trump, ICE raids and gas prices flipped the San Joaquin Valley: resilient Republican David Valadao lost to Randy Villegas, who ran on economic populism.

stories.title: More than a dozen runners fall ill at Santa Barbara half-marathon
stories.take: At least 19 runners were hospitalized at the Santa Barbara half-marathon Sunday — organizers blame heat exhaustion, though medical professionals have not made a final determination.

stories.title: L.A. had its worst mosquito year this decade. El Niño could make it even worse
stories.take: L.A. had its worst mosquito year this decade and California has its highest West Nile activity in five years — El Niño could make next year worse.

stories.title: CalMatters sues Shasta County over its refusal to disclose federal subpoena related to election ballots
stories.take: CalMatters is suing Shasta County for refusing to disclose a federal subpoena allegedly tied to June 2026 election ballots.

stories.title: Empowered congressional Democrats gear up for battles over immigration and ICE oversight
stories.take: Empowered congressional Democrats plan to level up ICE oversight and rein in Trump's immigration enforcement once they hold the House and Senate majorities.

stories.title: The man who fought napster is now fighting AI
stories.take: RIAA chief Mitch Glazier, who fought Napster, says labels, artists and listeners are now aligned against AI training without permission — unlike the Napster split • His case: copyright protects the human connection fans pay for; fully machine-made music will lose that connection, while assistive AI may be accepted like synths and Auto-Tune • The RIAA is just 46 people against $2T AI companies and ~$250M in AI super PAC money — its asset is trusted artists as messengers

stories.title: DF Direct Weekly #289: Should Zelda Use DLSS? Nintendo HDR Issues, Xbox FSR 4.1.2 Performance
stories.take: Answer on Zelda and DLSS: the panel splits on DLSS — the engine likely lacks the motion vectors it needs and DLSS would force a lower input resolution — but agrees FSR 1 was the wrong choice, with its over-sharpening and shimmer; even FXAA would be preferable, though Nintendo should tackle DLSS eventually • Nintendo's first-party HDR is 'fake': an SDR filmic curve stretched into HDR with no extra detail — yet the same approach looks beautiful in Metroid Prime 4 and poor in Mario Kart World and Zelda; workaround: HDR + dynamic tone mapping + black frame insertion on an OLED • Xbox FSR 4.1.2, in Microsoft's own numbers: ~3.86 ms for a 4K upscale on Series X (Lite ~2.75 ms), memory in FSR 3's ballpark • God of War Laufey delayed to May 20, 2027

stories.title: Nvidia investigates CEO's affair with suspected Chinese spy
stories.take: Nvidia opened an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's affair with a woman suspected of spying for Beijing — the board says no evidence so far that he shared sensitive information, and Trump called Huang a 'fine person' • A man shot six people dead in central Krakow in an attack police link to far-right ideology; two days of national mourning declared • COP climate summit opens in Antalya as scientists put the chance 2026 is a record-hot year at ~95% • Egypt train crash south of Giza killed at least seven and injured more than 110

stories.title: China denies spying on Nvidia boss
stories.take: China dismissed the Nvidia spying claims as a smear — author Stephen Witt says 'Jensen got played' by Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, whose data centers allegedly diverted chips to China, and congressional investigators from both parties want Huang to testify • BBC investigation: Marseille's DZ Mafia recruits teenagers across France on social media for murders and kidnappings — lookouts from age 11–12, ~1,000 arrested since 2024 • COP31 opens in Turkey focused on delivering past promises; warming trajectory is down from ~4°C to ~2.8°C but 1.5°C will be missed and the US is absent • David Warner backs Usman Khawaja's claim the whole Australian team knew about Sandpapergate

stories.title: This Is How New York City Takes Out Its Trash
stories.take: How NYC takes out its trash, step by step: curb (bags, increasingly bins) → collection trucks, mostly midnight–8:30 a.m., routed to fill at ~12–13 tons → one of five transfer stations → containers sealed by robotic arms → out by barge or rail; one barge of 50–75 containers replaces 50–75 truck trips • DSNY moves 24 million pounds a day for 8.5 million people as a free, unlimited service • Containerization is finally replacing the black-bag era — a 1968 Lindsay-era bet on plastic bags that failed on rats almost immediately

stories.title: Why Stocks Had Their Best Day Of The Year — Then Their Worst
stories.take: The answer: the best day was a relief rally — Dow +3% (best since April 2025), S&P and Nasdaq ~+1.5%, oil −8% — on certainty, gridlock, and bets the war and tariffs end sooner • The worst day flipped it: Dow −1,000+ points and Nasdaq −5% into correction as a data-center backlash hit — 40 of 41 local data-center ballot measures lost, and new Democratic governors in Ohio, Georgia and Texas (40%+ of planned capacity) campaigned on slowing them • Hosts' bottom line: no consistent theme in two days, leverage amplified the swing, and it's unclear whether a data-center slowdown helps hyperscalers (ends the capex race) or hurts them

stories.title: After a Crushing Defeat, Trump Doubles Down
stories.take: After a historic midterm defeat, Trump replaced chief of staff Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller — Haberman and Swan say that discounts all his talk of compromising with Democrats; Miller means a war footing, 'base, base, base,' and more immigration crackdowns • Miller pitched himself as the man to reassemble the MAGA coalition, but the voters who left were largely non-MAGA Biden-unhappy voters who flip back and forth • Wiles was blamed for losses driven by Trump's own calls — the Iran war and tariffs — in a job where the gatekeeper role barely exists for Trump

stories.title: Why data centers and Musk lost but billionaires won the midterms
stories.take: The answer in three parts: data centers lost — 44 of 45 ballot measures restricting them passed, most with 75%+ • Musk lost — he spent ~$500M backing dozens of Republicans and most lost, including $200M+ in Texas for Paxton and Abbott, who both lost • Billionaires won — California's Prop 40, a one-time 5% wealth tax meant to raise ~$100B, looks set to fail after Brin and others spent $300M+ against it • The Magnificent Seven lost $1T on Thursday as the politics turned against AI buildouts

stories.title: Raman condemns ICE, Races still too close to call, Cruise ship rescue— Morning Edition
stories.take: Mayor-elect Nithya Raman joined protesters and condemned ICE after federal agents clashed with protesters at a Boyle Heights hospital — two people arrested • Races still too close to call: LA Council District 9 is within 347 votes and Irvine Council District 1 within 174 • Coastal flood advisories are at their highest risk today, with surf building to 4–7 feet • A cruise-ship pianist was rescued off Catalina after ~9 hours in 76-degree water; the Lakers beat Detroit 121–116 behind Austin Reaves' 43

stories.title: Torrenters are building epic media collections
stories.take: Private torrent trackers — invite-only, ratio-enforced communities capped at tens of thousands of members — have sustained epic, curated media collections for ~20 years, acting as preservation archives and human discovery engines, not just piracy • Getting in is a years-long status game: build ratio and reputation in easier trackers to reach elite movie communities; bounties pool credit for rarities — an unpublished Salinger story drew a ~6 TB bounty before a 1-of-25 print copy surfaced on eBay • Members are strikingly candid that it's illegal — less 'stick it to the man' than the streaming-box era — while enforcement has shifted to ISP notices, European settlement letters and MPA/ACE raids • Plus: the $599 'Enough Phone' and why cheap phones are dying

stories.title: Trump's Post-Midterm Changes, Lame-Duck Congress, Nvidia Huang Investigation
stories.take: Stephen Miller starts as chief of staff today, replacing Susie Wiles — NPR's Mara Liasson calls him a hardliner on mass deportations and unchecked executive power, signaling confrontation with the new Congress, not compromise • That collides with Trump's own 60 Minutes admission that deportations 'might be too tough' — and a weekend episode where he floated, then joked away, offering Dana White the press secretary job • Lame-duck Congress must fund the government by Dec. 11, pass defense authorization, weigh a Hegseth impeachment vote, and rush through judge confirmations before Democrats take over in January • Nvidia investigates whether its own CEO was targeted by Chinese intelligence

stories.title: What Does Beijing Know About Nvidia’s Jensen Huang?
stories.take: The answer: it isn't known — 'it's unclear what Beijing has learned,' and what, if any, Nvidia information was already shared with the Chinese government • US officials concluded Alice Huang of Singapore-based Megaspeed was sharing information with Beijing; Nvidia's board is probing whether CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with her was a honey trap • US concerns are twofold: smuggling Nvidia chips into China, and offshore data centers giving Chinese AI firms remote access to Nvidia compute • Also: lawmakers weigh impeaching Defense Secretary Hegseth in the final 55 days of Republican majorities, and Trump told 60 Minutes his deportation policies may have gone too far
